assertions.name: proton_pred_within_threshold
assertions.source: substrate-derived E_0 prediction (CAL-1 + CAL-2 only) compared against m_p_validation

description: Round-2 neutron-gap probe per prop:full-pole-structure-mass-trace. Evaluates the FULL symbolic Markov trace tr_M(T_w, q_0) directly from the Habiro-coefficients witness — no Wedderburn-channel truncation, no V_3term approximation. Pairs the full tr_M with the substrate-derived Planck-tick energy scale E_0 = m_e / (q_0 · (q_0 - 1)) (CAL-1 + CAL-2 only) and the three-calibration neutron chain m_n = m_p + Q_β + m_e. No proton-mass calibration: m_p_validation / m_n_validation are comparison targets only. Workplan-0b Bucket D rewire (PR #759).

data.verdict: h4_full_tr_M does NOT close the gap
data.recommendation: H4 with substrate-derived E_0 gives proton err -9.95e+08 ppb, neutron err -9.94e+08 ppb (threshold 1e+07). Structural finding: tr_M(p, q_0) ≈ 1.065 from the Habiro witness is normalised at a scale where the implicit E_0_calibrated ≈ 880.8 MeV would match m_p, NOT the substrate-derived Planck-tick E_0^(N=0) ≈ 4.186 MeV. The previous proton-calibrated form (E_0 = m_p / |tr_M(p)|) absorbed this ~210x scale discrepancy into the calibration tautology m_p = m_p. The mismatch lives in either the Habiro tr_M normalisation convention, missing brane-tower factors, or in the link between tr_M and the substrate Planck-tick scale.
